sourceFile: 43. BRS-161016  Report test dry VP to find NG reason function unstable_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid cited result data but incorrectly merges two distinct test contexts into one changed factor.
issues: Distinct 13.5 dry-vs-normal test is merged with 15.6 storage-preserve-condition test.
Baseline and changed conditions are over-broad and mix separate test rounds.
Change domains include unsupported coating and dimension/spec labels.
15.6 condition-definition rows are not cited in the changed-factor evidence.
Review title and purpose reflect only the 13.5 sheet, not the full workbook.
correctionPlan: Split into two review cases or two changed factors by sheet/test round.
For 13.5 use normal temperature as baseline and Dry VP as test condition.
For 15.6 use Normal preserve condition as baseline and compare inside WH, outside WH, and outside WH plus dry 80C.
Set change domain to process/material preservation or storage/drying condition only.
Add cited rows for 15.6 title, purpose, content, and test definitions.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Result row citations are mostly sufficient for metrics, but changed-condition citations need added context rows.
